body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Pandigital(www.pandigital.net) presented its digital floating photo frame at the CES 2009.
Coming in 7-inch model(PAN7003DWPCF1) and 8-inch model(PAN8000DWPCF1), the digital floating photo frame combines a stunning floating LCD frame design with true touch screen technology.
Other features included 1GB of internal memory supporting up to 6400 images, 6-in-1 card reader, WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity.
